learner_operation: Identify the polynomial inner function and outer integer power; compute n*g^(n-1)*g prime, then select or enter the result. For source higher levels, evaluate at the point and form a tangent line.

fixed_features.feature: Polynomial inner, positive integer outer power, source response types
fixed_features.justification: Defines this KP rather than the neighboring radical-chain-rule KP.

fixed_features.feature: Easy affine inner; bounded coefficients and positive power 2..6
fixed_features.justification: Preserves easy source workload while varying sign, multiplier and resulting exponent.

answer_roles.role: Correct radio position and coefficient rank
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any position; coefficient/multiplier ranks can vary while derivative rule stays fixed.
answer_roles.observed: Grid designs vary ranks and omitted cells; raw order shuffled and UI independently orders choices.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Canonical quartic+cubic and question quartic+linear; coefficient changes should change both derivative terms.
answer_roles.observed: Both degree one and degree three sampled and explicitly constructed; relevant changes propagate through question, bank and solution.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary abscissa, coefficients, outer power within source workload.
answer_roles.observed: Counterfactual points change slope/tangent and reject stale response; sign and power changes also propagate.

coverage.result: 24 fresh seeds: 11 degree-one and 13 degree-three. Both groups have varied leading coefficient ranks, outer ranks and raw positions.

coverage.case: Every practice source and canonical example
coverage.result: 12 practice banks reproduced with documented corrections; canonical function and derivative now exact.

coverage.case: Unchanged nine templates and exact easy batch
coverage.result: Three fresh records per unchanged template plus 108 prior stratified unchanged records. Batch has three radio and two blank records, varying signs, powers and constants.

counterfactuals.expected: Derivative/slope/tangent must change; old response rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: 24*x**2 + 72*x + 54 -> -24*x**2 + 72*x - 54; native cross-response rejection passed; both prompts and solutions rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: Chain rule and source point evaluation depend on this coefficient, exponent or abscissa.

counterfactuals.expected: Derivative/slope/tangent must change; old response rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: 24*x**2 + 72*x + 54 -> 64*x**3 + 288*x**2 + 432*x + 216; native cross-response rejection passed; both prompts and solutions rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: Chain rule and source point evaluation depend on this coefficient, exponent or abscissa.

counterfactuals.expected: Derivative/slope/tangent must change; old response rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: 8 -> 216; native cross-response rejection passed; both prompts and solutions rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: Chain rule and source point evaluation depend on this coefficient, exponent or abscissa.

counterfactuals.expected: Derivative/slope/tangent must change; old response rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: 8*x + 1 -> 216*x - 135; native cross-response rejection passed; both prompts and solutions rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: Chain rule and source point evaluation depend on this coefficient, exponent or abscissa.

counterfactuals.change: 3+2x versus 2x+3, fixed a=2,b=3,n=3 and seed 4401 across affine layouts.
counterfactuals.expected: Same polynomial derivative and equivalent radio answers, despite term order and answer bank order.
counterfactuals.observed: Both keyed expressions expand to 24*x^2+72*x+54; all radio choices independently graded; prompt and solution renders inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: Addition commutes; source affine layouts present both constant-first and variable-first forms.

counterfactuals.change: Holding seed=99173,a=3,b=1,n=5 and bank design fixed, second_power 1 -> 3.
counterfactuals.expected: Inner derivative changes from 12*x^3+1 to 12*x^3+3*x^2; entire derivative and solution update.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt, key and worked inner/final derivatives independently match; native grader accepts exactly the differentiated choice and rejects all four distractors on both records; actual UI shows both functions and derivatives.
counterfactuals.justification: Canonical e-181 versus quartic-plus-linear practice q-48625 requires differentiating the second term according to its degree.

counterfactuals.change: Reverse the complete answer-choice array of the cubic canonical instance.
counterfactuals.expected: Same mathematical derivative and keyed answer UUID; visible order may change without changing correct response.
counterfactuals.observed: Same UUID accepted by native grader after reorder; exact derivative and solution preserved and actual UI inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: Source radio ordering is incidental to the chain rule; all five responses remain unchanged.

stages_examined: shared publisher normalization and identity validation
weighted difficulty selection and learner-history exclusion
delivery.result: 5/5 exact easy batch, 9/9 independent easy and 24/24 independent moderate quartics survive. Both changed degree cases remain available within moderate band; easy batch remains affine. No tested fixed surface cue solves the changed-family groups or the exact radio batch.

limitations: Finite probes cannot establish absence of all shortcuts.
No live learner history/policy or future entity IDs provided. Selection claims use captured basis 5615 and conditional rule analysis, not a prediction of future frequencies.
UI choice order hashes task item and field IDs; input array positions are not stable live answer positions.
Unchanged families reuse prior independent evidence with matched source, inventory, batch and engine bindings; only changed construction and a small regression sample are newly tested.
